subtitle: A cliff-base pebble beach on Lefkada, closed by land since 2025 but still sold daily by the boatload.
spike_statement: Egremni's road and stairs have been reported closed since 2025; after 2026 storm damage a private initiative fixed them, and no engineer has certified it.

levers.photo_tone: Bone-white limestone cliff dropping into deep turquoise water, the staircase a thin scar switchbacking down the rock face
